messages:
Oscar L: Hey @finance - corpcard soft-declined at the rental desk in BCN, had to put incidentals (fuel + tolls) on my personal card. Need to submit for reimbursement and confirm VAT reclaim rules.

Charge split: rental base on corp card, incidentals on personal = EUR 42.15 (fuel) + EUR 6.40 (toll) = EUR 48.55. Posted 2026-04-02.
Receipt: https://files.redwood/receipts/rental-2026-04-02.jpg
Concur claim started: `EXP-2026-0599`

Nina (Finance): Thanks Oscar. Two notes: 1) We reimburse incidentals covered personally — upload the itemized receipts and your card statement line. 2) For VAT reclaim: fuel VAT is usually reclaimable if vendor provides invoice with tax ID. Toll charges are non-recoverable in many EU countries (we treat them as non-VAT). If vendor invoice only shows total without VAT line, we reimburse but cannot reclaim.

Oscar L: Got it. The fuel vendor emailed a simple PDF receipt that shows VAT 21% and tax id. Toll is just a highway slip with no VAT. I'll upload both.

Liam (Manager): Approving expense `EXP-2026-0599` for travel incidentals.

ExpenseBot: Expense `EXP-2026-0599` status changed to `Submitted` by Oscar L.

Nina (Finance): Once you upload the fuel invoice (with vendor tax id) tag me and I'll kick off VAT recovery. For the toll we'll mark it as non-reclaimable. Also, please set category `Travel - car rental` and add note: "split payment - corp rental charged; personal card for incidentals".

Oscar L: Uploaded receipts and statement. Fuel invoice number `ES-FUEL-9982`, VAT EUR 7.16 included. Toll slip uploaded too. Tagged @Nina.

Nina (Finance): Received. Routing fuel to VAT queue. Reimbursement will be processed in next 5 business days. Any VAT recovered later posts to finance — we don't split reclaimed VAT back to individuals.

Oscar L: Quick Q - do I need to do anything for the rental company's pre-authorization hold on the corpcard? The hold is still pending and I don't want it to block other charges.

Nina (Finance): Pre-auth holds clear automatically once rental finalizes (usually 7-10 days). If it persists longer, open a ticket with card ops and cc me.

ExpenseBot: Expense `EXP-2026-0599` status changed to `Approved` by Liam. Estimated processing in 3-5 business days.

Oscar L: Thanks all, appreciate the quick help :pray:
